sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Consignment and Secondhand Luxury Goods Retail

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law, and customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations) FTA
No comprehensive double tax agreement applies to Vanuatu's tax-exempt international company regime

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (Act No. 13 of 2022, as amended), supplemented by the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], the VFSC International Companies Regulations, and directives of the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); UBO records are mandated for international companies and kept at the registered office in Vanuatu.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing government authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is a Hague Convention member; otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for each UBO that will be named in the beneficial ownership register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: A licensed bank in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct confirmation from bank; notarization or apostille only if demanded by VFSC or the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and register of directors/members for any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant's home-company registry or equivalent corporate registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, signatories and beneficial owners against the VFIU watchlist, United Nations Security Council sanctions list, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, UK and EU sanctions lists, and the domestic Vanuatu PEP list; enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification and adverse-media review are required for all PEPs and any counterparties located in FATF-listed high-risk jurisdictions; results must be documented in the client due diligence file and retained for at least 5 years post-business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry / Name Reservation System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be in Roman script; English and French names are acceptable; non-Roman scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters; the name must contain the word 'Limited' or an accepted abbreviation (e.g. 'Ltd') and must not be misleading as to the company's nature.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If VFSC rejects a proposed name, the applicant (or its licensed registered agent) must first obtain a written rejection notice. Within 14 calendar days, a written appeal may be submitted to the Registrar of International Companies at VFSC, stating the proposed name, grounds of rejection, supporting evidence (including consent letters for sensitive tokens), and the preferred alternate name. The Registrar is required to issue a determination within 7 working days. In parallel, a fresh name reservation application can be filed for an alternate name; if the appeal is dismissed, the alternate reservation proceeds. There is no statutory extension of the 30-day reservation period; reservations expire automatically and the name becomes reavailable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is permissible for day-to-day correspondence but cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement; an International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of a licensed registered agent. For an online vintage luxury resale platform (ISIC 4791, no statutory e-commerce license), the physical-inspection risk profile is low to moderate because no high-risk financial services license is held, but the registrant should expect annual verification and unannounced visits by the registered agent and, in targeted cases, VFSC examination.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 30-40% probability of an on-site inspection or registered-agent site visit within the first 24 months of operation, reflecting the 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced' AML rating.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name search and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule published by VFSC; market benchmark US$75-US$100

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation fee (standard share capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for International Company registration under the International Companies Act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and registered agent service - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Vanuatu IC maintenance packages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO profiling, AML/KYC due-diligence file preparation and PEP/sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider / external AML compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat professional fee per UBO entity; enhanced due diligence for Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille/consular legalization and authenticated document courier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, competent apostille authority, foreign consulate and courier service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Pass-through of government and professional fees at prevailing market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent compliance contingency fee for on-site inspection / annual corporate maintenance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / local compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark retainer for inspection-readiness and regulatory correspondence support

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222), ss. 3-26 (Incorporation and Constitutional Documents), s. 27 (Registered Office), ss. 66-75 (Directors and Secretary), ss. 76-84 (Meetings and Resolutions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitutional Documents) submitted, together with statutory notices, by a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for an International Company. The company may issue shares with or without par value; any subscription consideration received before certificate issuance is held in the licensed Registered Agent's client account pending incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers' share subscription and initial allotment be and are hereby ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company in Port Vila, Vanuatu, as designated in the Memorandum, is adopted and that the licensed Registered Agent is authorised to continue as agent for service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Director Name] is appointed as sole Director and that the Company Secretary, as required by the International Companies Act, is appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Director is authorised to open bank and escrow accounts, execute the business license application, engage the bookkeeper, and execute all ancillary documents. RESOLVED FINALLY, that minutes and the register of directors be maintained at the registered office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Licensed Registered Agent and Company Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry and a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Registered Agent and submit two proposed company names for clearance. The agent files a name reservation application with the VFSC; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company and must not contain restricted words without prior regulatory consent. The agent also undertakes the statutory customer due diligence on the ultimate beneficial owner.
required_dossiers: Notarized passport copy of the ultimate beneficial owner
Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent for any corporate shareholder
Letter of engagement with the licensed Registered Agent
Bank reference or professional reference letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, submit two alternative names through the same Registered Agent, or file a written appeal using the VFSC name-review request. The registry determines the appeal within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association, including company name, registered office clause, objects, share structure, transfer provisions, and indemnity clauses. The subscribers and the appointed director execute the documents before a notary public or commissioner for oaths; the Registered Agent countersigns and dates the execution pages after verifying the identities of the signatories.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Shareholder register and share allocation schedule
Consent letter of the nominated director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries a clause, the Registered Agent files a supplemental memorandum of amendment with annotated and initialled changes; full re-execution of the constitutional documents is not required provided the amendment is recorded in the company's statutory register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation File to the VFSC Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent submits the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the notice of registered office, the notice of director and secretary, the consent to act of the director, and the prescribed filing fee through the VFSC electronic filing portal or in-person registry counter. The registry stamps the file, opens the statutory company record, and commences the examination of the constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notice of Directors and Secretary (Form IC-5)
Identity verification file of the subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC issues a query notice, the Registered Agent responds in writing within fourteen days, correcting the cited item and resubmitting. If the application is rejected, the applicant may request a partial refund of the filing fee and must file a fresh application with a new cover letter referencing the original file number.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Initial Capital Subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review of the incorporation file, the VFSC registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The subscribed shares are entered in the register of members, and share certificates are executed under the company seal affixed in the presence of the director and the Registered Agent. The paid-up subscription amount, if any, is released to the company's corporate account or held in escrow as directed by the board.
required_dossiers: Capital subscription receipts or bank transfer records
Certified copy of the constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains typographical or legal name errors, the company submits a written re-issuance request accompanied by the original certificate; the VFSC re-issues the corrected certificate within two business days upon payment of a nominal administrative fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License Application and Tax Identification Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue and Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the annual business license under the Business Licence Act, describing the online consignment and secondhand luxury goods retail activities. The International Company is not chargeable to Vanuatu corporation tax on foreign-source income but must obtain a Tax Identification Number, complete the business license fee assessment, and confirm whether VAT registration is required based on projected domestic turnover thresholds.
required_dossiers: Narrative description of the online consignment and resale business model
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licensing authority requests further particulars of the consignment model, the applicant files a supplemental business description demonstrating that goods are shipped directly to end-customers by suppliers, thereby avoiding a physical stock-in-trade presence in Vanuatu. Any license fee dispute is resolved through written submission to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Formalities and Banking Readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board of directors and the licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene or pass by written resolution the first board meeting to approve the banking and escrow payment infrastructure, appoint the AML compliance officer, adopt the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing manual, and authorize the execution of e-commerce platform agreements. File the first annual return with the VFSC and maintain the statutory registers at the registered office.
required_dossiers: First Board Minutes or written resolutions
Bank or escrow account opening application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AML officer appointment is queried by the VFSC or a correspondent bank, the board passes a supplemental resolution appointing an alternative qualified officer and files a revised notice; the VFSC accepts the cure without penalty if filed within the statutory fourteen-day correction window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce, Vanuatu
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for Retail and On-line Consignment Activities (ISIC 4791) issued under the Business Licence Act [Cap 250]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-impact commercial activity — Registration Notification under Schedule 2 of the Vanuatu Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations; no Full EIA Report required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or combustion emissions arise from the consignment warehouse. The facility must maintain zero hazardous waste discharge, segregate packaging waste for recycling, and limit any use of VOC-emitting cleaning agents to concentrations consistent with Vanuatu ambient air guidelines; water-based alternatives are preferred. Storage and shipping materials must comply with the DEPC waste management standards, including the prohibition on importing prohibited substances.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Service for the storage and dispatch facility; structural load inspection certificate for shelving and racking systems; workplace clearance from the Department of Labour confirming safe working conditions, adequate ventilation, and compliance with the Employment Act and child labour prohibitions.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (part of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management), operating through the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs portal; company registration and licensing authority for International Companies is the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing an International Company in Vanuatu must register the company with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), obtaining a Certificate of Incorporation and a VFSC registration number. Because Vanuatu imposes no income tax, no tax identification number (TIN) or VAT ID is issued for direct tax purposes. For customs operations, the entity must separately register as an importer/exporter with the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department and obtain a customs identification code, typically through lodgment of an importer/exporter application in the ASYCUDA World customs system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The Vanuatu International Companies Act provides no 'check-the-box' or hybrid mismatch election mechanisms. International Companies are categorically exempt from direct and indirect taxation on offshore income; an IC may elect to become a domestic company for restricted onshore activity, which subjects it to business license fees and ordinary customs duties, but no elective tax classification regimes analogous to US or EU systems exist.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no national VAT or GST; indirect taxation limited to customs import duties and specific excise taxes)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. No VAT/GST exists in Vanuatu; therefore there is no registration threshold for such a tax. Customs importer/exporter registration is mandatory for any entity undertaking import or export activity regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu imposes no electronic invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate. Customs export declarations must be processed through the ASYCUDA World electronic customs management system, which requires submission of supporting documentation and generation of export clearance. There are no digital stamping or continuous transaction control requirements for indirect tax purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Vanuatu does not levy VAT or GST, so there is no zero-rating mechanism for exports. Exports simply fall outside the scope of any national indirect tax; no refund claim process exists for output tax because no output tax is charged. Exporters must comply with Vanuatu Customs regulations to obtain export clearance, but no indirect tax refund is available or required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank transfer / SWIFT proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There are no VAT export zero-rating clawback provisions applicable in Vanuatu because no VAT regime exists. However, false or fraudulent customs declarations are penalized under the Customs Act, including monetary fines, forfeiture of goods, and suspension or revocation of the entity's import/export privileges. For International Companies, failure to comply with VFSC annual renewal and reporting obligations can also result in penalties, deregistration, and loss of the statutory tax exemption.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), exercising statutory authority under the Reserve Bank Act [Cap 125], the Exchange Control Act [Cap 86], and the Financial Institutions Act [Cap 279] for the Republic of Vanuatu.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is formally convertible on both capital and current account with no general restrictions applicable to non-resident International Companies. Vanuatu operates a liberalised exchange control regime; however, banks retain de facto internal controls on the funding of International Company accounts. Dividend and profit remittance from an International Company to non-resident shareholders is generally unrestricted provided the company is not in local currency debt, the remittance is clearly identified as distributable profits, and any applicable annual/original filing obligations with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) are met. Trade-related payments for luxury resale transactions are treated as current account payments and do not require RBV approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory timeline for surrendering export proceeds nor any mandatory conversion ratio. Vanuatu does not impose forced surrender of foreign currency export earnings to the RBV or to an authorised dealer. Proceeds can be retained in foreign currency, deposited in an offshore-capable corporate account, and used for operational disbursements without RBV conversion requirement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium to Low. Vanuatu does not maintain a distinct electronic money institution (EMI) licensing class, and RBV-regulated banks are the only institutions able to hold client funds domestically. Offshore digital EMIs can clear payments globally but the International Company must still rely on a local bank or an established offshore acquiring bank for actual VUV settlement, merchant services, and escrow integration. Legal constraints include: absence of EMI reciprocity between Vanuatu and EU/UK licensing frameworks, heightened de-risking risk toward Pacific-jurisdiction corporates, and the inability of an unlicensed offshore EMI to open a nostro account with RBV-regulated banks. The optimal pathway is to use a tier-one local bank for fiduciary segregation and a licensed EU/UK EMI (e.g., for USD/EUR payouts) only as an auxiliary disbursement rail, never as the sole treasury facility.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The Banking Act and Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) framework permit account opening for an International Company without physical presence of all directors, but the RBV-regulated banks generally mandate at least one director, a corporate secretary, or an authorised signatory to appear for an in-person interview at the bank or at a recognised Vanuatu branch. Remote account opening with video identification is possible only for joint/venture relationships supported by existing banking relationships, and is subject to enhanced due diligence. For a fully non-resident ownership structure of the Vintage Luxury Resale entity, a physical onboarding session in Port Vila is strongly recommended to unblock escrow and merchant acquiring facilities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership obscured by International Company nominee shares
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A certified register of beneficial owners, a signed nominee declaration waiver, valid passports of all ultimate beneficial owners, proof of address not older than three months, and a legal opinion from a VFSC-licensed registered agent confirming the company structure and the commercial substance of the online luxury resale business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk payment geography or expected large-volume online card settlements via Stripe and Escrow_Pay
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed platform service agreements with Stripe and Escrow_Pay, detailed business model narrative describing the vintage luxury sourcing and resale workflow, historical or projected settlement volumes, transaction monitoring procedures, and a copy of the AML/CFT compliance manual adopted by the company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border trade with significant value-per-item and seller/payee names not aligned to purchase invoices
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authenticated supplier/consignor identity files, commercial invoices and authenticity certificates for each luxury item, chain-of-custody documentation from acquisition to resale, contracts with third-party authentication labs, and a representation letter confirming no proceeds are derived from intellectual property infringement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No physical office or staff in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent services agreement, availability of a service address in Port Vila, board resolutions confirming that the International Company is managed by a non-resident board under Vanuatu law, and a substantive economic activity narrative including worldwide operational decisions, ecommerce system access, and treasury management controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected FX mismatch between inflow (USD/EUR) and outflow (VUV or offshore supplier currencies) exceeding threshold triggers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy and FX hedging strategy, detailed cashflow projections, setting out planned conversion volumes, identification of the relevant FX dealer and permitted NDF agreement, and bank-approved account purpose documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections into the International Company must be completed by SWIFT MT103 transfers using the bank routing code (BIC) of the receiving Vanuatu bank, with the memo field citing the purpose code 'EQUI' (equity injection) or 'AN13' (trade-related funding) depending on the correspondent bank's format. All remittances should be accompanied by a board resolution, a shareholder subscription schedule, and a signed remittance mandate to satisfy the bank's source-of-funds verification. Payment instructions must not omit the International Company's registered agent reference number. For escrow advance funding or merchant acquiring rolling reserves, the route is either (a) direct MT103 from the sentiment account of Stripe/Escrow_Pay to the operational account, using the merchant ID and reserve release reference, or (b) a two-step wire through a licensed EU/UK EMI prior to final settlement to the Vanuatu account. Only RBV-authorised banks may convert foreign currency to VUV; conversion requests must be accompanied by an underlying trade or treasury instruction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for procurement of vintage luxury inventory are executed through SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers from the company's operational account to the beneficiary's bank account, with purpose code 'TSUP' (trade services and related commission) or 'AGRT' (goods-related payments), plus commercial invoice number and a unique trade reference. For high-value acquisitions exceeding USD 50,000, an Irrevocable Confirmed Commercial Letter of Credit (LC) drawn on an international bank is the recommended clearing rail to mitigate supplier risk. Escrow-linked disbursements are released only against authenticated delivery acceptance triggers recorded in Escrow_Pay. For intra-group or platform fee payments to Stripe/Escrow_Pay, using a dedicated settlement account within an EU/US regulated EMI reduces friction and avoids per-transfer VUV conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on VUV/USD with a licensed international financial institution, settled in USD, for the majority of non-convertible VUV exposure
Outright onshore forward contract for VUV/USD booked by an RBV-authorised bank, only when the underlying receivables and payables are reasonably determinable
Offshore cross-currency swap between USD and EUR used to hedge the luxury resale procurement and sales currency mismatch
FX spot orders through the corporate e-banking platform, limited to executed trade disbursements and not speculative

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Government Fee Renewal and Annual Return Form
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the anniversary date of incorporation of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penalty of 10% of the unpaid annual fee for each month or part of a month overdue; if the fee and penalty remain unpaid for six months after the due date, the VFSC may strike the International Company off the register, resulting in dissolution of legal personality and requiring court-supervised restoration for reinstatement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Register Update and Secretarial Confirmation (maintenance of Register of Members and Register of Directors)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent acting as licensed secretarial officer under the International Companies Act, retained for VFSC inspection readiness
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On-going; annual attestation must be completed no later than the anniversary date and within 14 days after any share transfer or director change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain and submit the annual confirmation of registers to the registered agent is treated as a default under the International Companies Act; the registered agent may resign after giving notice, and the VFSC may issue a compliance directive or strike-off notice if the company remains non-compliant.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No independent statutory audit is compulsory for a private International Company engaged in online consignment and resale of vintage luxury goods. An audit becomes mandatory only if the company obtains a VFSC financial services or securities dealer licence, or if shareholders representing at least 10% of the voting rights validly require an audit in writing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for any prepared statutory financial statements; internal records may be maintained under simplified accounting practices acceptable in Vanuatu, provided they reflect true transactions and support the required seven-year retention obligation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation consists of the registered agent updating the register of members to reflect all shareholding transfers and submitting the required beneficial ownership schedule to the VFSC as part of the annual return. Vanuatu does not maintain a public beneficial ownership registry; the registered agent must retain beneficial owner identification, sanctions screening records, and anti-money laundering CDD files for a minimum of seven years.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 6,000 (only if voluntarily commissioned or required by a financial services licence)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are fully exempt from any corporate income tax; no nominal tax, no tax holiday, no preferential deductions. Only an annual government fee is payable to VFSC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. Compliance consists of the International Company Annual Declaration and renewal paid to the VFSC through the licensed registered agent (electronically via VFSC portal or paper).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on each anniversary of incorporation; not keyed to fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of International Company, registration number, date of incorporation and registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter details exactly as per the Certificate of Incorporation; non-resident owners may act through the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationality, residential address and passport details of all directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign individuals may provide the nationality and passport data; a registered agent must hold a beneficial ownership record if required under VFSC directives.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of compliance and payment of the annual government renewal fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent remits the fee; no additional non-resident tax form is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal triggers a 10% surcharge; continued non-payment results in strike-off from the International Companies Register. If the company trades after strike-off, directors incur personal liability for the company's debts.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreements (only TIEAs with Australia, New Zealand, Canada, etc.). No Vanuatu tax certificate is required to distribute dividends. A recipient relying on foreign tax credit should obtain a certificate of non-residence from its own tax authorities; Vanuatu will not levy any WHT requiring a TRC upload.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic WHT on cross-border royalties and interest is 0%. Treaty rate is not relevant as Vanuatu does not impose interest/royalty withholding and has no applicable DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable (no Vanuatu transfer pricing rules, no Local File/Master File threshold; local currency VUV but no tax base is assessed).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations. An International Company is required to maintain a registered agent, registered office and limited records. Substance criteria of shareholder tax jurisdictions and EU/OECD lists may impose requirements; a shell IC without any operational footprint may be re-characterized.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion via False Exemption Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely declaring to foreign tax authorities that the IC is a Vanuatu non-resident entity while managing its business and key activities from a high-tax jurisdiction, or carrying on prohibited Vanuatu domestic business without authorization.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu International Companies Act: monetary penalties, strike-off and loss of corporate privileges. In the investor's jurisdiction: substantial understatement penalties (e.g. 100–200% of unpaid taxes) and criminal prosecution for willful evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be assessed personally under anti-avoidance and fraudulent tax rules; international travel bans and extradition are possible where indictable tax fraud is committed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a paper-only IC with no genuine business operations, no bank accounts, no contracts, and no physical presence, used to route luxury resale profits from source jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's VFSC can impose administrative sanctions for failure to maintain registered records; OECD/G20 actions can designate the company as a shell; foreign tax authorities may apply GAAR/CBCR penalties and disregard its existence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: In civil proceedings, courts may pierce the corporate veil and impose restitution on directors for amounts repatriated; asset freeze and liability for group tax debts can follow.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the online resale platform to move value on behalf of sanctioned persons, structuring fund transfers, accepting unidentified third-party funds, or operating an unlicensed escrow/payment service contrary to Vanuatu's Financial Dealers Licensing Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offense under Vanuatu AML/CFT framework: fines up to Vt 100 million or higher, imprisonment up to 20 years, revocation of registration and seizure of proceeds; international consequences include loss of correspondent banking and FATF countermeasures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may face personal criminal prosecution; travel bans, extradition, and personal asset forfeiture are expressly authorized.
